description: This file contains inline assembly optimized functions for big number (BIGNUM) arithmetic operations on x86_64 architecture, including multiplication, squaring, addition, and subtraction of large integers, with specific functions for 4- and 8-word numbers. It is part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library, specifically for accelerating big number computations using inline assembler.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication of a big number array by a word and adds the result to another array, using inline assembly for efficiency.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Multiplies a big number array by a word, storing the result in another array, optimized with inline assembly.

methods.name: bn_sqr_words
methods.description: Squares a big number array, optimized with inline assembly.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds two big number arrays, with inline assembly handling carry propagation.

methods.name: bn_sub_words
methods.description: Subtracts one big number array from another, with inline assembly for borrow handling.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba8
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two 8-word big numbers using Comba multiplication with inline assembly.

methods.name: bn_mul_comba4
methods.description: Performs multiplication of two 4-word big numbers using Comba multiplication with inline assembly.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba8
methods.description: Squares an 8-word big number using Comba squaring with inline assembly.

methods.name: bn_sqr_comba4
methods.description: Squares a 4-word big number using Comba squaring with inline assembly.
